area_operator.extent_interpretation: Extent is derived from native prognostic area with fixed calibrated seasonal zero-intercept multipliers (March 1.1626984241; September 1.4457143786). Extent metrics are diagnostic and are not independent scientific evidence.

evidence_partition.1979-2020: calibration and validation-informed development; not independent validation

1979-2024.title: Sea Ice Concentrations from Nimbus-7 SMMR and DMSP SSM/I-SSMIS Passive Microwave Data, Version 2

source_product_transition.interpretation: The packaged table preserves the Sea Ice Index v4 source-data identifiers. No claim is made that NSIDC-0051 and NSIDC-0803 are measurement-identical; product transition effects are part of the observational uncertainty.

march_area.interpretation: Non-overlapping five-year target blocks reduce shared-year leakage, but the emulator trajectory was tuned after the historical record was inspected. Scores are descriptive development diagnostics, not predictive validation.

march_area.interpretation: The correction for each target year is the mean model-minus-observed error from earlier years only; no target or future observation is used.

march_extent_trend_robustness.mandatory_limitation: March extent is a diagnostic proxy rather than an independently prognostic spatial extent field. Historical records were inspected during development and are not independently validated prediction skill.
march_extent_trend_robustness.raw_area_exclusion_reason: The packaged area series changes pole-hole masks across sensor eras; its full-period slope is not a homogeneous physical target.

march_native_area_trend_robustness.reason: The packaged area series changes pole-hole masks across sensor eras; its full-period slope is not a homogeneous physical target.

prospective_untouched_temporal_evaluatio.reason: Records through 2025 and March 2026 were already inspected. From 2025 onward the packaged source changes to AMSR2/NSIDC-0803, so prospective skill must be reported as a separate product-era evaluation or use a predeclared overlap adjustment.

quantitative_temporal_skill_claim.reason: The historical record was inspected during development and does not constitute independent predictive validation, irrespective of baseline skill.

rolling_origin_historical_evaluation.method: Each target year is compared with the fixed emulator trajectory, one-year observed persistence, and an expanding observed linear trend estimated only from prior years.

evidence_role: historical calibration and previously inspected development evaluation; not independent predictive validation
